COLD SPRINGS / PROJECT 01

A foundation for your decisions.

This is the first spatial model of the Pramer residence at Cold Springs. Explore the room layout, windows, circulation, and ceiling volumes before choosing finishes.

2,819 sq ftLiving area971 sq ftGarageOctober 28Plan revision, 2026

What this version includes

Walls traced from A-1 at the drawing scale, openings, a cathedral great room, an attached garage with its floor transition, covered porch and rear patio. The model plan is available from any view.

Dimensional review

The dimensioned framing spans and nominal opening tags have been checked against A-1. Some heights, roof details, finish build-ups and site levels still require confirmation. Read the measured results and unresolved items →

Still open for design

Flooring, paint, cabinetry, furniture, fixture styles, and interior lighting are neutral placeholders. The client’s selections can be added independently to this house.

Drawing assumptions and unresolved details

    This model supports design discussion; dimensions and construction details should be checked against the issued drawings.
